title: The Five Aces from Chicago and Bob Sackerman
summary: The Chicago band Harold heard, its members, and saxophonist Bob Sackerman.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene
